name: Forms Steps
description: Provides Drupal multiple forms steps capability using forms views.
project_description:
Back to top 

 Description 
 Forms Steps provides an UI to create forms workflows using forms modes. It creates quick and configurable multisteps forms.

You will be able to add and mix lot of steps using all the entities compatible with drupal 8 form modes.

 This project is born in top of a real business case. The core of that module is in use and all new features will be integrated.

 Back to top 

 Roadmap 
 
 Sub modules for advanced features like managing config forms and custom forms without entity, or other entities not compatible with the form mode concept. 
 Provide better documentation.
